thread.title: People are discovering that scammers are controlling their Apple accounts using a feature for families to share apps (AAPL)

author: Kif Leswing
title: People are discovering that scammers are controlling their Apple accounts using a feature for families to share apps (AAPL)
text: People are discovering that scammers are controlling their Apple accounts using a feature for families to share apps (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Jun 27, 2018, 5:18 pm 47 pts Scammers in China are hijacking people's Apple IDs and making purchases via an iPhone and Mac feature called "Family Sharing." The feature is designed to help families share apps and music, but the scammers are using it lock out the actual owner of the account and buy in-app purchases and iTunes…
